name: Ducted rocket - hoverslam landing (evolved suicide burn)
notes: SpaceX-style suicide burn: dropped at 50-70 m AGL, already falling 10-20 m/s, a few metres off a pad. Craft: ducted rocket + 4 grid fins (passively stable in a tail-first fall). A JS landing controller (velocity-vs-altitude burn profile + vane attitude/position loops) whose 10 gains are evolved with CMA-ES. Reward: touchdown speed, tilt, pad distance, fuel (throttle-seconds); big crash penalty. The starting gains light the engine too late and crash.
